items.title: fix(ci): harden workflow audits and recover partial releases
items.body:
Checkout hints obscured CI output, the workflow audit hid 22 template-injection findings, and a delayed PyPI release could leave every later release attempt failing on duplicate uploads. This change applies the checkout policy everywhere, audits those findings, and resumes publication whenever either the PyPI version or its published GitHub release is missing.

### Changes

- Configure Git before checkout in docs, security and workflow validation, with a policy regression covering every checkout workflow.
- Pass layout and release metadata through environment variables in every shell step. Use zizmor-action v0.6.4 with one shared zizmor 1.30.1 pin and a low-confidence regular audit; retain the pedantic security audit.
- Pin Secretlint and its preset to matching 13.0.7 versions.
- Check exact PyPI and GitHub release artifacts in automatic and manual releases for both root and `python/` layouts. Skip duplicate files in both publish actions and the standalone Twine publisher; preserve published GitHub releases and publish existing drafts during recovery.
- Wait up to 600 seconds for the exact PyPI version before the installation smoke test, with bounded requests, optional retry tracing and an actionable partial-success timeout message.
- Exclude both experiment directories through a wired CodeQL config. Add the commented `.lycheeignore` template and limit GitHub link requests to concurrency 2 and a one-second interval while preserving the existing failure/recovery gate.
- Add documentation and a changelog fragment, which prepares the next release through the existing version-bump/fragment workflow.

The [requirement-by-requirement analysis](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/blob/issue-98-ebe758ce06fc/experiments/issue_98_analysis.md) lists every parent/sub-issue requirement, alternative solutions, selected plans, original log evidence, official online sources and related implementations. All listed issues were present; none needed an already-resolved exception.

### Reproduction and regression coverage

Before the fix, zizmor 1.30.1 at low confidence reported all 22 injections; the new workflow policies failed 11 cases, and GitHub release recovery tests failed twice. Original checkout-hint logs were downloaded and inspected. The old tag gate suppresses a missing release when a tag exists and republishes an already-uploaded version when no tag exists.

```bash
python experiments/reproduce_partial_release.py
pytest tests/test_issue_98.py tests/test_check_release.py tests/test_create_github_release.py
pytest --cov=src --cov-report=term
```

The reusable experiment compares the baseline tag gate with artifact recovery and simulates four minutes of propagation lag. Automated tests cover all four artifact states in both layouts, draft/published releases, API failures, retry deadlines, remaining request budgets, environment outputs, and real local HTTP responses/redirect rejection. PR checks do not perform a live PyPI upload; publication recovery is verified offline.

### Validation

- Full local suite: **360 passed, 1 skipped** (layout-specific skip); 100% shipped-source coverage.
- Ruff lint/format, mypy, file-size limits, changelog validation and Sphinx with warnings as errors: passed.
- Pinned actionlint with shellcheck, zizmor regular/low-confidence and pedantic/high-severity scans, and Secretlint 13.0.7: passed.
- Final commit `575aaa5a91a3eb8456c3dca9442e344120a1b328`: **all five workflows passed**, with 22 passing checks and six expected skips. Run timestamps are after the commit and all run head SHAs match it: [CI/CD](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/37585143577), [Workflows](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/37585143641), [Security](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/37585143589), [Docs](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/37585143587), [Links](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/37585143571).
- Fresh docs/security/workflow logs contain zero `Using 'master'` hints. The only first-push failure was a new research citation returning HTTP 403 (saved log `ci-logs/links-37584951016.log`, lines 285/305; final classification at 336). Replacing it with verified exact-version npm registry metadata resolved the link check.
- Default branch is included, the full GitHub diff was reviewed, and the working tree is clean.
